description: Functional programming patterns for TypeScript and JavaScript: pure functions, immutability, composition, currying, higher-order functions, and Result and Option types. Applies the fp-ts rules when the codebase imports fp-ts. Trigger on "how do I avoid mutation", "how do I curry this", "how do I handle async errors without try-catch", or "make this more functional". For general typing questions use typescript-best-practices.
